items.title: 5.13 Viscous drag aur Stokes ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13 with the viscosity table (PDF 112).

blocks.text: Behte fluid ki mukhtalif tahon (layers) ke darmiyan ragar (friction) ke asar ko viscosity (gaarhapan) kehte hain. Viscosity batati hai ke liquid ki ek tah ko doosri tah par phisalane ke liye kitni force chahiye. Jo cheezein aasani se nahi behtin, jaise gaarha tar (taarkol) aur shehad, un ka coefficient of viscosity bara hota hai; ise Greek harf ‘η’ (eta) se likhte hain. Jo aasani se behti hain, jaise pani, un ka coefficient of viscosity chhota hota hai. Liquids aur gases dono ki viscosity zero nahi hoti, is liye un mein kisi cheez ko chalane ke liye force lagani parti hai. Hawa ki thori si viscosity bhi tez chalti car par bari rokne wali (retarding) force paida karti hai. Tez chalti car ki khirki se haath bahar nikalein to fauran mehsoos hota hai ke haath ko hawa mein se guzarne ke liye kafi force lagani parti hai. Yeh sab neeche wali haqeeqat ki misalein hain.

blocks.caption: For Your Information: 30°C par liquids aur gases ki viscosities

blocks.title: Drag force
blocks.text: Fluid mein chalti cheez par ek rokne wali force lagti hai jise drag force kehte hain. Cheez ki speed barhne se drag force bhi barhti hai.
Saada tareen soorat mein bhi drag force ki theek value nikalna mushkil hai. Lekin fluid mein chalte hue sphere (gend jaisi gol cheez) ka case bohat ahem hai.
Agar radius r wala sphere viscosity η wale fluid mein aahista speed v se chal raha ho, to us par drag force F Stokes' law se milti hai:
Lekin zyada speed par yeh force speed ke seedha proportional nahi rehti.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Chimney tab sab se achha kaam karti hai jab woh oonchi ho aur hawa ke jhonkon ke saamne ho. Oopar se guzarti tez hawa chimney ki choti par pressure kam kar deti hai, aur dhuan zor se oopar ki taraf nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Aatishdan (fireplace) ki aag se eenton ki chimney chhat ke slab se guzar kar oopar uthti hai. Safed dhuan neele teeron ke saath chimney mein oopar jata hai. Hawa ki neeli lakeerein chimney ki choti par se guzarti hain aur oopar se nikalta dhuan un ke saath mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 112): Lambi aur hawa ke rukh par chimney behtar kaam karti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Choti par se tez hawa guzarti hai to wahan pressure kam ho jata hai (Bernoulli). Neeche aag ke paas pressure zyada hai, is liye dhuan zor se oopar dhakela jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Viscosity se kya murad hai? Agar sphere ka radius dugna aur speed aadhi kar di jaye to us par Stokes drag kitna badlega?
blocks.explanation: Viscosity fluid ki tahon ke darmiyan andar ki ragar hai, jo ek tah ko doosri par phisalane ke liye darkaar force se napi jati hai; shehad aur tar ka η bara, pani ka chhota hai. F = 6πηrv mein F, r × v ke proportional hai; r dugna aur v aadhi karne se r × v wahi rehta hai, is liye drag wahi rehta hai.

items: Viscosity η: fluid ki tahon ke darmiyan andar ki ragar (tar, shehad: bari; pani: chhoti; hawa 0.019 × 10⁻³ N s m⁻²).
Fluid mein chalti cheez par drag force lagti hai jo speed ke saath barhti hai.
Aahista chalta sphere: Stokes' law F = 6πηrv (5.28); zyada speed par F speed ke seedha proportional nahi.
